title: Minimum Path Sum
summary: Find the least total cell value on a route from the upper-left to the lower-right, moving only right or down.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–200 rows and columns. Cell values are in [0,200].
contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned int.

statement: Find the least total cell value on a route from the upper-left to the lower-right, moving only right or down. Include both endpoints in the sum.

examples.explanation: The route contains one zero-valued cell.
A single column forces every cell.

constraints: 1–200 rows and columns. Cell values are in [0,200].
hints: Conceptual: Every route into a cell uses one of two predecessor directions.
Directional: Keep the cheapest cost for each processed cell.
Implementation: For each cell, add its value to the smaller reachable cost from above or from the left. A single row of DP storage suffices.
complexityAnalysis: O(rows×columns) time and O(columns) auxiliary space.
